item.title: Procura – Finance Manager
item.summary: Hey everyone, i am building an ai powered finance manager called procura, it uses ai to find the cheapest listing of the product your business need and purchase it for you. i am looking to charge $500/mo for it. is it worth it or not. Note:- it does not handle the payments Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49407193 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
